ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) central field and high-intensity (white) localized zones on the distal lobes and upper trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation occupies the central and proximal fluke areas. High-intensity white/grey mottling is concentrated on the distal ends of both lobes, with transition zones showing speckled white-on-black pixels toward the medial region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression at the fluke center; vertex depth is visible but the precise pixel angle is partially obscured by splash/water-surface intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the horizontal boundary; peaks and valleys exhibit pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels across the entire length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex curvature originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the dark central and lower surfaces of both lobes; a dense concentration is visible on the distal edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the mid-left lobe, primarily oriented vertically and diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular biological clusters (barnacle colonization) with high-intensity tan and white pixels attached to the extreme distal points of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'C-shaped' or circular ring marking visible on the upper pigmentation of the right lobe.
